items.smell_name: Calculation Rule Drift / Unversioned Rate Reference

Sinkhole Collapse endorsement: 'may be endorsed to provide' — optional coverage language with undefined scope and no mandatory disclosure; smell 1 overbroad exclusion pattern
Limited Fungi endorsement: coverage grant qualified by 'limited' with no defined scope — coverage inversion via restrictive qualifier that narrows apparent coverage without enumerated limits
Earthquake Coverage endorsement: optional add-on with its own deductible structure — smell 3 pattern where optional endorsement creates coverage inversion relative to base policy
